prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1301; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a two-lane road. Insured states the other vehicle drifted into their lane while they were signaling and moving over. Claimant reports a shoulder injury and says they are not represented by an attorney. Initial contact made by phone; recorded statement scheduled.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from the insured. Insured describes the lane change as gradual and says a side mirror on their vehicle was struck. Photos of both vehicles requested. Police report number obtained from the insured and cross-referenced with the responding agency.

Entry 3: Claimant contacted by phone. Claimant confirms they are not represented and wishes to handle the claim directly. Claimant describes ongoing shoulder pain and limited range of motion and states they have been referred for a medical evaluation. Advised claimant of the medical documentation needed to support the injury portion of the claim. Vehicle damage estimate requested from the assigned appraiser.

Entry 4: Appraisal received for the claimant's vehicle, covering rear quarter panel and passenger door damage. Estimate reviewed against photos on file. Medical records authorization form sent to claimant by mail and email. Liability review in progress; the other driver's account conflicts with the insured's on whether a turn signal was active.

Entry 5: Claimant returned the signed medical authorization and provided initial treatment notes from the treating clinic. Notes indicate a rotator cuff strain with physical therapy recommended. Liability assessment updated to reflect shared fault pending review of a witness statement. Injury claim placed on hold until the medical file is complete. Follow-up scheduled with the claimant.
